items.title: Calcutta High Court blocks streaming of Sabeer Bhatia's video on Modi-Adani ties
items.summary: The Calcutta High Court recently ordered a ban on online streaming of the video titled "The Friendship Files| How Modi and Adani Stole India" after Adani Enterprises filed a defamation suit [Adani Enterprises Limited VS Sabeer Bhatia and Ors.] . Justice Aryak Dutt said that the injunction will remain in force till January 31, 2027, when the case will be heard next. The Court said that the video, made by Indian-American businessman Sabeer Bhatia in collaboration with another channel called "Shadow Citizens", is not a news report. Justice Dutt observed that the imputations that the Adani Group is complicit in, or has been shielded from accountability for, narcotics smuggling linked to terror funding or police violence against a farmer are not substantiated by any authority. It noted that the original video was already disabled but Bhatia uploaded it again. It prima facie shows lack of good faith, the Court added.
